description: This file contains unit tests for the WPEFramework Core DataElement, DataStore, and LinkedDataElement classes using Google Test framework. The tests verify functionalities such as copying, resizing, CRC calculation, searching, setting/getting numbers and bits, and linked data behavior.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: A class representing a data element with capabilities for copying, resizing, CRC calculation, searching, and bit manipulation.

classes.name: DataStore
classes.description: A class managing a buffer with size operations and validation.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: A class representing linked data elements that can be enclosed and linked, supporting operations like copying, size retrieval, and buffer management.

classes.name: DataElementParser
classes.description: A parser class for DataElement objects, providing size and validity checks, and byte skipping.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data from an array or another DataElement into the object.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Retrieves or sets the size of the data buffer.

methods.name: CRC32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over data.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the DataElement is valid.

methods.name: Buffer
methods.description: Accesses the underlying data buffer.

methods.name: SearchNumber
methods.description: Searches for a number within the DataElement with specified endianness.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Sets a number value within the DataElement with specified endianness.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Searches for a byte sequence within the DataElement.

methods.name: SetBitNumber
methods.description: Sets bits within the DataElement.

methods.name: GetBitNumber
methods.description: Retrieves bits from the DataElement.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a value at a specified offset.

methods.name: Align
methods.description: Aligns the DataElement data.

methods.name: Enclosed
methods.description: Encloses one LinkedDataElement within another.

methods.name: SetBuffer
methods.description: Sets the buffer range within LinkedDataElement.

methods.name: GetBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the buffer range within LinkedDataElement.

methods.name: LinkedSize
methods.description: Returns the size of linked data.

methods.name: LinkedElements
methods.description: Returns the number of linked elements.

methods.name: SkipBytes
methods.description: Skips a number of bytes in the parser.
